lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; project retained. Line 12 of each business's Form 4562 takes 'the amount allocated to the business or activity from the "Summary"' (i4562 p. 5, Line 12). When the return's deduction equals the amounts elected (s179.differs false) the project enters this business's own elections (sc.s179_elected, its lines 6 and 29), and copies the return's line 12 only when they differ, refusing then with more than one Schedule C (s179.multi). The second copies the return's line 12 to every business, which counts the deduction once per business when there are two and the amounts do not differ (s179.multi does not refuse that case). Evaluated: fixture classm.s179.2 with wages raised so the income limit does not bind (s179.line12 = s179.line8 = $10,313, elected on biz_a only) gives line 12 of $10,313 for biz_a and $0 for biz_b; the second would enter $10,313 on both.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. The project sums asset.bonus_2025 (asset.bonus for property placed in service in 2025, zero otherwise) over property that is not listed; the second sums asset.bonus over the same property filtered to placement in 2025. The same total for every set of assets.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. The project sums asset.dep_prior (asset.macrs_prior for property placed in service before 2025, zero for 2025 property) over property that is not listed; the second sums asset.macrs_prior over property that is not listed and not placed in service in 2025. The same total for every set of assets.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. Both report periods y15 and y15sl on line 19e, as the line's label includes qualified improvement property (i4562 p. 10, 15-year property); the project sums asset.dep_2025 (zero for property not placed in service in 2025) over the two periods, the second sums asset.macrs2025 over the same periods filtered to placement in 2025. Ruling: equivalent; project retained. Line 21 is line 28 on both sides; the project copies sc.f28, which is sc.f25 plus sc.f26h, and the comparison expands that helper but keeps the second's line 28 as a reference.

Ruling: model error; project retained. The second sums asset.f25, which copies asset.bonus for every listed asset whatever its year (shown_when asset.on_26_2025 only hides it); the project sums asset.bonus_2025, zero for property placed in service before 2025. Line 25 is for listed property placed in service in the tax year (i4562 p. 13, Line 25: 'If you placed in service certain qualified listed property during the tax year, you may be able to deduct the special depreciation allowance'). Evaluated: fixture stage14.asset.listed_prior (a listed camera placed in service in 2024, $5,000 at 60%) with its class answered bonus_choice full gives asset.f25 $3,000 and asset.bonus_2025 $0, so the second's line 25 would be $3,000 where the project's is $0. The vehicle term (scveh.bonus) is the same on both sides.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. The second adds a more-than-50% business-use filter to both terms; the project reaches the same set because listed property used 50% or less is refused (asset.listed_low through asset.basis; scveh.low_use through scveh.placed), and a vehicle on the standard mileage rate or leased has scveh.macrs zero. The tests are the same: asset.pct above 50 (asset.over_half) and business miles above commuting plus other miles (scveh.over_half). Equal in every admitted case.

Ruling: model error; project retained. The second adds its line 25, line 26(h) and a line 27 term; the line 27 term (listed property used 50% or less) is zero wherever the project admits the return, since that property is refused (asset.listed_low, scveh.low_use), and 26(h) agrees, but its line 25 includes the special allowance of listed property placed in service before 2025 (see the line 25 ruling; i4562 p. 13, Line 25, 'placed in service ... during the tax year'). In the case evaluated there (stage14.asset.listed_prior, bonus_choice full) the second's line 28 would be $3,734.70 against the project's $734.70.

Ruling: model error; project retained. The second sums asset.f26i, a copy of asset.s179, over listed property used more than 50% whatever its year; column (i) is the section 179 election, which applies only to property 'that you placed in service during the tax year' (i4562 p. 3, Part I; p. 16, Column (i): 'Refer to the instructions for Part I to determine if the property qualifies under section 179'). The project sums asset.s179_2025, zero for earlier property. Evaluated: the 2024 listed camera of fixture stage14.asset.listed_prior with asset.s179 answered $1,000 gives asset.f26i $1,000 and asset.s179_2025 $0; the project's line 29 is $0 (s179.line7 $0), the second's would be $1,000. The more-than-50% filter is equivalent, since listed property at 50% or less is refused.
